title: Plumeform teal gradient card footer
description: A footer card inset a few pixels from the window, rounded on top, fading from deep teal to near-black green: wordmark and tagline with a quiet link and a paper pill on the right, five columns of links under tracked capitals, a row that opens to more links, and a bottom line with copyright, legal links and an email address.
notes: forces dark colours over a chart-1 gradient
the expanding row is native <details>; CSS only
